components.cost_effect: Exact global cubic minimization is an additional resource.
components.name: Cubic Taylor majorizer
components.operation: Add L||s||^3/6 to the exact quadratic model.
transfer_checks: Reprove the bounds for approximate solves or inexact derivatives.
Finite-domain use must verify containment; this record uses R^d.

limitations.statement: No finite arithmetic or Hessian-vector complexity for exact global solves is established here.
The guarantee concerns this Algorithm and these outputs; no unrestricted Oracle Complexity optimality claim.

performance_links.scope_note: Exact full-space Algorithm with best-gradient-iterate output.

variants.cost: For k steps: k Hessian queries at x0,...,x{k-1}, k exact global cubic solves, and k+1 gradient queries at x0,...,xk; intermediate gradients are reused. Zero value queries are required. Model-solve arithmetic, storage, linear algebra and Hessian-vector costs are separate and unquantified.
variants.implementation_details_ref: PDF p.5 (2.4); p.8 (3.3) and fixed-L paragraph. Section 5.1 pp.20–22 is context, not an extracted finite arithmetic implementation.
variants.name: Fixed M=L with exact global cubic solves
variants.output: For fixed budget, return any best-gradient point among x1,...,xk. For accuracy stopping, return the first checked point meeting epsilon. These output wrappers are explicitly local additions to source (3.3).
public_inputs: x0 in R^d; known valid L>0; integer k>=1 or epsilon>0. A gap bound is needed only for an a priori budget.
variants.query_and_update: At xi query gi=grad f(xi), Hi=Hess f(xi). Globally minimize qi(s)=gi^T s+s^T Hi s/2+L||s||^3/6 over R^d, choosing any global minimizer si. Set x{i+1}=xi+si. An arbitrary stationary point is insufficient. No value acceptance test is required with a valid known L.
variants.requirements: f:R^d->R is C^2 with globally L-Lipschitz Hessian in spectral norm. Exact gradients, Hessians and global cubic minimization are available. The linked guarantee additionally requires a finite global lower bound f_low.
variants.state_and_initialization: Initialize x=x0. Retain the best gradient norm among generated points for fixed-budget output.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Use M=L throughout. Fixed budget: perform k steps and evaluate grad f(xk). Accuracy mode: check each generated point and stop at the first with gradient norm <=epsilon; an optional initial x0 check can stop immediately. Given a valid Delta>=f(x0)-f_low, max(1,ceil(12 sqrt(L)Delta/epsilon^(3/2))) steps suffice.
